note: Regions for tools/milair.py. Boxes are [west, south, east, north] in degrees, copied from Watchfloor's published zone boxes (metacog-osint/more-context, scripts/build_interests.py BOXES, 18 Nov 2026), keyed by Watchfloor's warning problem. Watchfloor's Red Sea box overlaps its Gulf box, so here it is split into two boxes that stop at the Gulf box's edge: no two regions overlap (tests/test_milair.py checks). The Gulf comes first. 'weekend' gives the region's weekend days for the baseline (Python weekday numbers, Monday 0): Friday-Saturday [4, 5] where Watchfloor's zone countries keep that weekend (the Gulf states, Israel, Yemen; Iran's is Friday), and the data show the dip on those days; else Saturday-Sunday [5, 6], the default. Watchfloor's Somalia box (WF-WP-Z19) is left out for now because it overlaps the Red Sea box.
